functions.name: setup
functions.description: Install and verify node, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

args.name: version
args.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

args.name: install-dir
args.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

args.name: package-name
args.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

args.name: sudo
args.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

functions.name: setup
functions.description: Install and verify rust, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

args.name: version
args.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

args.name: install-dir
args.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

args.name: package-name
args.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

args.name: sudo
args.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

args.name: toolchain
args.description: Rustup toolchain channel or exact release; alias for version. Both must agree when provided.

args.name: components
args.description: Comma-separated Rustup components to install, such as rustfmt,clippy; omitted or blank values add no components.

args.name: targets
args.description: Comma-separated Rust target triples to install, such as wasm32-wasip2,wasm32-unknown-unknown; omitted or blank values add no targets.

args.name: profile
args.description: Rustup installation profile: minimal (default), default, or complete.

functions.name: setup
functions.description: Install and verify cachix, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

args.name: version
args.description: Expected Cachix version from the configured nixpkgs registry entry; latest accepts the packaged version. An explicit version mismatch fails setup.

args.name: install-dir
args.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

args.name: package-name
args.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

args.name: sudo
args.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

args.name: cache
args.description: Cachix cache name to enable with cachix use after installation; omit for CLI-only setup. Public caches need no token; private caches use inherited CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN.

functions.name: check
functions.description: Evaluate and build flake checks without modifying flake.lock.

args.name: project
args.description: Working directory containing the source checkout; defaults to the current directory. Default: ".".

args.name: run-dir
args.description: Fresh directory for this invocation’s execution report and task logs; must not already exist.

args.name: executable
args.description: Native CLI executable name or absolute path; defaults to this operation’s tool.

args.name: timeout-ms
args.description: Maximum task duration in milliseconds; defaults to 900000. Default: 900000.

args.name: artifacts
args.description: Output artifacts to collect as NAME=PATH entries; names must be unique.

args.name: flake
args.description: Local flake path or reference to inspect; defaults to the selected project checkout. Default: ".".

functions.name: flakehub
functions.description: Publish the checked-out flake release to FlakeHub using GitHub OIDC.

args.name: project
args.description: Working directory containing the source checkout; defaults to the current directory. Default: ".".

args.name: run-dir
args.description: Fresh directory for this invocation’s execution report and task logs; must not already exist.

args.name: executable
args.description: Native CLI executable name or absolute path; defaults to this operation’s tool.

args.name: timeout-ms
args.description: Maximum task duration in milliseconds; defaults to 900000. Default: 900000.

args.name: artifacts
args.description: Output artifacts to collect as NAME=PATH entries; names must be unique.

args.name: name
args.description: FlakeHub flake name as OWNER/REPOSITORY; no repository name is hardcoded.

args.name: version
args.description: Release tag to publish, such as v1.2.3.

args.name: visibility
args.description: Flake visibility: public, unlisted, or private. Default: "public". Allowed values: public, unlisted, private.

args.description: Output artifacts to collect as NAME=PATH entries; names must be unique.

args.name: version
args.description: Release version or tag to publish, such as v1.2.3.

args.name: ref
args.description: Git commit SHA corresponding to the selected release and checkout.

args.name: readme
args.description: Repository-relative README filename used by the Flakestry registry. Default: "README.md".

args.name: url
args.description: HTTPS Flakestry registry origin; also used as the GitHub OIDC audience. Default: "https://flakestry.dev".

args.name: ignore-conflicts
args.description: Treat HTTP 409 for an existing release as success; other HTTP errors still fail. Default: false.
